findings.title: Scheduled backup and restore-test workflows never run because they are absent from the default branch
findings.note: RE-VERIFIED at main 9c0b88c: backup-dispatch.yml, db-backup.yml, db-restore-test.yml and storage-backup.yml are all present on the default branch (git ls-files .github/workflows | grep backup|restore). findings.title: The restore test never asserts integrity and therefore cannot fail on a bad backup
